svg.title: A-100 Ground Floor Plan
svg.text: S T R E E T
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Living, dining and kitchen read as one space, linked by
2.00 m and 1.50 m wide arched openings; arch heads are
2. South elevation glazing to the living room and TV lounge
is arched and faces the 23 m garden corridor.
3. The ground floor sits 0.50 m above the garden: three
risers at 167 mm at the entrance and at the patio doors.
4. The east boundary wall is solid at this level: the
adjoining owner may build up to 3.00 m against it. Every
room here is ventilated from the garden elevation or the
5. Guest bath and laundry are internal rooms: mechanical
extract to the light court at six air changes per hour.
6. The guest bedroom is single sided onto the light court,
and is 4.00 × 3.50 m clear of the fitted wardrobe. Its
door is undercut 15 mm to draw make-up air from the
7. Gross internal area excludes the light court.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
